selection_rule: one record per exact_reference choice-contract decision (goal selection included) whose menu offers >= 2 states and passes the 32K token gate; first 64 eligible decisions per (task, algorithm) in episode order; walk tasks, stop at the target; last task may be partial
walk_order: seed-major: for seed ascending, the 24 strata in (domain, difficulty) order (ambiguity resolution; see protocol doc)
